description: Reduced non-degenerate shifted oscillatory angle-structured quadrature-QAE microcampaign. This keeps the G_4^(3) shifted oscillatory test but uses K={0,1}, because the K={0,1,2} dry run made k=2 too deep for a controlled Kingston submission.

selected_jobs.purpose: Non-degenerate degree-3 angle-structured quadrature instance with a controlled reduced MLAE schedule.

rejected_full_schedule.reason: k=2 exceeds the controlled hardware regime for this microcampaign.

stopping_rules: Run first without --submit and verify that k=1 remains close to depth 334 and 139 two-qubit gates.
Submit only the reduced K={0,1} schedule.
Use the result to test whether a non-degenerate G_4^(3) instance remains usable with one Grover iterate.
Do not infer full K={0,1,2} viability from this reduced run.
